点星系进入分组 · 按 / 搜索群聊 · 拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放: Click a galaxy to enter a group · press / to search clusters · drag to turn · scroll to zoom

绕行星转的属于该群员，绕恒星转的属于整个群聊。点卫星看详情；「知道了」只在这个浏: Satellites around a planet belong to that member; those around the star belong to the whole cluster. Click one for details. “Got it” hides it in this browser only and does not change what is read.
点星系、恒星系统进入；点恒星打开 Hub 群聊，点行星打开该群员的原生对话。宇宙: Click a galaxy or star system to enter it. Click the star for the Hub chat and a planet for that member's native conversation. The black hole in a corner of the universe is the trash. Press / or Ctrl+K for the cluster list, searchable by cluster, group or member name. Drag to turn the view, scroll to zoom (all the way in enters, all the way out goes back), double-click empty space to reset, Esc goes up a level, F shows the frame rate.
方向键选择 · 回车打开 · Esc 关闭 · 按 / 随时打开: Arrow keys choose · Enter opens · Esc closes · press / any time
